hooks.command: echo 'HOOK: About to commit — have you run the reviewer agent? If not, consider invoking it first.'

branch=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); if [[ "$branch" == hypothesis/H* ]]; then hyp_id="${branch#hypothesis/}"; hyp_file=$(find . -name 'HYPOTHESES.md' -maxdepth 4 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -n "$hyp_file" ] && awk "/^## $hyp_id[^0-9]/,/^## H[0-9]/{print}" "$hyp_file" 2>/dev/null | grep -q '\`\[x\]\`'; then echo "BLOCKED: '$branch' is a concluded hypothesis branch. Switch to dev and create a new branch before making changes: git checkout dev && git checkout -b hypothesis/H{next}"; exit 2; fi; fi
